text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Boss!
What is this urgent matter you called me for!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, I had some business with Fenomeno, so I called her to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is this a letter, sir?
Just who could it be from...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Fenomeno-san.
Thank you for always watching over us—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone on your way to school! When crossing the street,
look right! Look left!
Cross carefully, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"At first, I thought her voice was loud
and her face was a bit scary.
But..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The sun is setting!
Watch out for cars, don't wander off,
and head home to your families with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"After meeting several times,
I've come to realize just how kind of a person you are."

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: "After that, I went to watch Fenomeno's race."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You were fast like the wind and so powerful!
Your face looked sharp and super cool, even
though I used to think it was scary!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become a cool Umamusume like you one day too, Fenomeno-san.
I'll keep cheering you on!"...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is...
choice_data_list: I figured you'd want to see it right away.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My sense of justice
had truly reached the children...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing, absolutely nothing else
that could make me happier than this, sir!
choice_data_list: All that hard work was worth it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
However, we can't rest on our laurels yet!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I must strive even harder from now on to be someone children can look up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To serve as a proper role model for the children,
I will continue to devote myself diligently to
my Public Morals Committee duties!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: So that these girls who will one day come to Tracen Academy can enjoy their school life to their hearts' content!
